title.zh: GDS装什么：保存层次化设计版图
title.en: What GDS contains: a hierarchical design layout

subtitle.zh: Cell、Polygon、Layer共同描述二维制造图形
subtitle.en: Cells, polygons and layers jointly describe two-dimensional manufacturing patterns

body.zh: EDA版图完成；布局布线完成；版图验证通过
body.en: EDA layout complete Placement and routing complete Layout verification passed

body.zh: 选择Top Cell；确定输出根节点；作为Top Cell
body.en: Select the top cell Select the output root as the top cell

body.zh: 3；Layer Map；配置Layer映射；（逻辑层→输出层）
body.en: 3 Layer map Configure layer mapping (logical layer → output layer)

body.zh: 4；Stream Out；.gds；生成GDS文件；写出版图数据库
body.en: 4 Stream out .gds Generate a GDS file Write the layout database

body.zh: 5；保留Hierarchy；保留层次结构；与引用关系
body.en: 5 Preserve hierarchy Preserve hierarchy and references

body.zh: Stream In / XOR；A.gds；B.gds；XOR；读入与比对；检查一致性
body.en: Stream in / XOR A.gds B.gds XOR Read and compare Check consistency

body.zh: 几何元素（构成图形）；Polygon · Path · Text；TEXT
body.en: Geometry elements (forming shapes) Polygon · path · text TEXT

body.zh: TOP CELL；Block A；Block B；Cell A1；Cell A2；Cell B1；Cell B2
body.en: TOP CELL Block A Block B Cell A1 Cell A2 Cell B1 Cell B2

body.zh: 层与类型（描述规则）；Layer · Datatype · Units；Layer 1；Layer 2；Layer N；Layer；1；2；Datatype；0；Units；nm；nm；N；nm
body.en: Layers and types (description rules) Layer · datatype · units Layer 1 Layer 2 Layer N Layer 1 2 Datatype 0 Units nm nm N nm

body.zh: GDS是版图数据库，不是晶圆实际成像结果
body.en: GDS is a layout database, not the actual wafer imaging result

body.zh: 结构控制 | Top Cell ．Cell Reference；Top Cell为输出根；Cell以引用方式复用；X/Y变换：平移、旋转、镜像
body.en: Structure control | top cell · cell reference Top cell is the output root Reuse cells through references X/Y transforms: translation, rotation and mirroring

body.zh: 几何控制 | Units • Coordinates • Bounding Box；Units：如 nm / μm；坐标精度与范围；Bounding Box定义范围；X
body.en: Geometry control | units · coordinates · bounding box Units: e.g. nm / μm Coordinate precision and range Bounding box defines the extent X

body.zh: 映射控制 | Layer•Datatype • Layer Map；逻辑层映射到输出层；Datatype定义用途；Layer Map保证一致性
body.en: Mapping control | layer · datatype · layer map Map logical layers to output layers Datatype defines purpose Layer map ensures consistency

body.zh: 层次化可减小数据量，但跨平台转换必须正确解析引用关系。
body.en: Hierarchy reduces data volume, but cross-platform conversion must parse references correctly

body.zh: 常见失效 | Cell缺失 • 单位错误• Layer映射错误• Top Cell选错
body.en: Common failures | missing cells · wrong units · wrong layer mapping · wrong top cell

body.zh: 验证反馈：DRC / LVS / Stream In / GDS XOR / Bounding Box；.gds；DRC；LVS；Stream In；GDS XOR；Bounding Box
body.en: Verification feedback: DRC / LVS / stream in / GDS XOR / bounding box .gds DRC LVS Stream in GDS XOR Bounding box

body.zh: 先进流程也常使用OASIS，不能把所有Tape-out数据都统称为GDS文件。
body.en: Advanced flows also use OASIS; not all tape-out data should be called GDS files
